programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The Makuwa team is fighting difficult weather conditions.The set stands on an uneven and icy surface, where chains on the wheels would be useful.The problem is that to install them, you have to lift the tractor, which may result in the 300-ton train tipping over.The decision is made by the head of the company, Kazimierz.Iwona Kapustka reaches the training ground where the museum tank was buried.The vehicle may prove to be too heavy even for a specialist roadside assistance tow truck.The team taking the pump to Hamburg is also having problems.Smoke is coming out from under the trailer.

programs.title: Mighty Truckers
programs.desc: The series tells the story of representatives of not the easiest profession - drivers of large-size vehicles.It involves long working hours, frequent fatigue, huge loads, and busy roads.These are just selected obstacles that truckers struggle with every day.However, they do not complain.On the contrary, they love their job and would not change it for any other.Now they will tell themselves where the passion for covering subsequent sections of European roads comes from: in Germany, Italy and the Netherlands.
